introduction.en: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) is a landmark rights-based legislation that guarantees 100 days of wage employment to rural households.
introduction.hi: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) is a landmark rights-based legislation that guarantees 100 days of wage employment to rural households.

body.en: It has significantly reduced distress migration and empowered rural women. It acts as a safety net during agricultural lean seasons. However, issues like delayed wage payments, corruption, and poor quality of assets created remain significant hurdles.
body.hi: It has significantly reduced distress migration and empowered rural women. It acts as a safety net during agricultural lean seasons. However, issues like delayed wage payments, corruption, and poor quality of assets created remain significant hurdles.

conclusion.en: To be more effective, the scheme needs better integration with local planning and stricter social audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
conclusion.hi: To be more effective, the scheme needs better integration with local planning and stricter social audits to ensure transparency and accountability.

valueAddition.en: Data: MGNREGA has been a critical lifeline during the COVID-19 pandemic, providing employment to millions of returning migrant workers.
valueAddition.hi: Data: MGNREGA has been a critical lifeline during the COVID-19 pandemic, providing employment to millions of returning migrant workers.
